verdict.rationale: Mailchimp exposes Marketing and Transactional APIs, so scoped API credentials are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents API keys with scopes, permissions, or least-privilege restrictions. The connected-accounts feature lets agencies switch between client accounts without sharing login information, which is an adjacent account-access feature, not scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
